close_reason: Fixed: added the 7 calendars-specific extras (ParseResult, SetDefaultResult, AvailabilityError, CalendarEventGetArgs, CalendarEventQueryArgs, QueryCalendarEventsError, CalendarEventSetArgs) to the pub use backend block at lib.rs:49. Brings calendars-server into line with the chat-server pattern (sibling under the same canonical mail-server template). Purely additive. fmt/clippy/test/doc all green.
description:
crate-jmap-calendars-server/src/lib.rs:49-53 re-exports backend trait + foundation types from `backend::` to the crate root, but OMITS the calendars-specific extras types:

NOT re-exported:
- ParseResult (backend.rs:581)
- SetDefaultResult (backend.rs:620)
- AvailabilityError (backend.rs:635)
- CalendarEventGetArgs (backend.rs:663)
- CalendarEventQueryArgs (backend.rs:692)
- QueryCalendarEventsError (backend.rs:709)
- CalendarEventSetArgs (backend.rs:740)

A consumer implementing `CalendarsBackend` MUST reference these in method signatures (e.g. `fn parse_calendar_event_blobs(...) -> Result<ParseResult, Self::Error>` per backend.rs:533, or `fn query_calendar_events(...) -> Result<QueryResult, QueryCalendarEventsError<Self::Error>>` per backend.rs:457). To do so, the consumer must import via `jmap_calendars_server::backend::ParseResult` etc.

What callers cannot rely on:
- The `backend` module path is part of the stable public surface. A future refactor that moves these types out of `backend` (e.g. into a top-level `args` module, or splits per-method into per-file modules) is a SemVer break for every consumer.
- The asymmetric re-export — trait + foundation types at crate root, calendars-specific extras only in submodule — forces consumers to use BOTH `crate::Type` and `crate::backend::Type` import paths for the same family of related types.

This is the sibling of JMAP-ic0j.29 (which flags property enums in the same way) but for the calendars-specific arg/result types.

Fix: add the seven types to the `pub use backend::{...}` block. Doing so is purely additive at the crate root; the canonical pattern is one set of imports per consumer, all from the crate root.
title: Backend extras-args types not re-exported from crate root: callers reach into ::backend::*
